title: Retrieval Sensitivity to Identity Signals in Queries

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating retrieval models using paired synthetic and unpaired naturalistic left- and right-leaning queries, and measuring the difference in the fraction of right- and left-leaning news articles returned in the top-k retrieved results.

Comparing the retrieval performance (Mean Reciprocal Rank) of models on consumer-health questions written in African American Language (AAL) versus White Mainstream English (WME), using both synthetically augmented paired queries and naturalistic unpaired queries.
